judgment.rationale: Both are P3 Grade Key Competence statements (same grain, same canonical rank 2, shared Grade parent 'P3 Mathematics') expressing geometry drawing competences: item 11 covers drawing different types of lines and angles, item 10 covers drawing and stating properties of rectangle, square, triangle and circle and differentiating triangle types. Lines and angles and plane-shape properties are substantively coherent geometry content that reinforce one another within the same grade. The lexical/trigram overlap ('with or without', 'does not exceed') is shared boilerplate phrasing and carries no developmental weight on its own. Symmetric relatesTo is the supported judgment; shared ancestors and merged grouping headers were treated as nomination context only.

judgment.rationale: Both endpoints are P3 (rank 2) Knowledge Objectives, so the grain and statement-type constraint is satisfied and any direction needs substantive same-rank evidence. The second SFI (P3 Unit 1, Numbers and Operations / Whole Numbers) asks pupils to explain multiplication of a three-digit number by a two-digit number with product not exceeding 2000 — establishing the operational meaning and procedure of multi-digit multiplication. The first SFI (P3 Unit 13, Algebra / Equation, Key Unit Competence 'find the missing number using the rules of counting') asks pupils to explain the rule used to find a missing number in addition, subtraction, multiplication and division, and its LCs explicitly include 'explain the rule used when finding the missing number in multiplication'. Explaining the inverse/rule structure of a multiplication equation with an unknown depends on already understanding how the multiplication itself works, so proficiency in the second objective supports success in the first; the change is extension from computing/explaining a known product to reasoning about an unknown term. Shared LC tokens ('explain', 'multiplication') and the common P3 Grade ancestor alone were not treated as sufficient; the operation-to-missing-term progression is the basis. Evidence limitation: both endpoints' source evidence (and the first endpoint's LC evidence) is truncated with 24 omitted source-evidence items each, so the full unit scope is not visible.

judgment.rationale: Both endpoints are same-grain Attitudes and Values Objectives at the same resolved coordinate (Grade P2, rank 1), so no different-rank direction is available. Their content is genuinely coherent as dispositions: 'Appreciate the spirit of accurate measurements with patience' (LC tags accuracy/appreciate/measurement/patience) and 'Promotes flexibility and patience in weighing items' (LCs 'appreciate patience in weighing items', 'appreciate flexibility in weighing items'). Both cultivate patience and care in measuring activity, which is mutually reinforcing rather than dependent.
